newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus stocks move lower during week.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus stocks move lower during week.

text.p: The Cyprus stock market dropped this week in what some analysts described as a bear run with persistent selling and limited buying, pulling stock values down 3.70 percent.
The 41-share Cyprus Stock Exchange (CSE) all-share index closed at 84.75 points, losing 3.25 points from last Friday's close of 88.00 points.

"The decline of most stocks across the board can be attributed to profit taking activity and the entry of the bears into the market as a counterattack to the bull market run that commenced in early August," said CISCO, the Cyprus Investments and Securities Corporation in its weekly report.

Cyprus's stocks have, with the exception of trading on Wednesday, been following a downward trend all week amid renewed tension on the divided island sparked by the killing of a Turkish Cypriot soldier on Sunday.

Tension has been running high on the island for the past month - first after the killings of two young Greek Cypriots by people from the Turkish Cypriot side in August and now by the shooting incident on Sunday.
The Turkish Cypriot side has blamed Greek Cypriots for the shooting. The Cyprus government has denied the claims.

Christodoulos Ellinas, a broker at Sharelink, says increased tension was one reason for the fall on the market. Another reason, he said, was that six month results of the Bank of Cyprus did not meet investor expectation.
On Wednesday the bank announced pre-tax gains of 12.18 percent to 12.9 million Cyprus pounds ($5.9 million) compared with 11.5 million in the first half of 1995.

But Ellinas said that news reports indicating smaller investors discontent at the planned takeover of novelty chain Zako by Woolworth Cyprus was also having an effect. Share values of both companies fell during the week.

Banking and insurance indices, which usually post the highest gains, lost considerable ground. The banking sub index closed at 91.54 points, down 3.4 percent from last Friday's closing figure of 94.77.
Similarly, the insurance company sub index fell to 61.62 points, falling 8.11 percent from last week's 67.06.

Fully paid shares of the Bank of Cyprus closed at 3.47 1/2, shedding 10.5 cents from last week's close of 3.58. Shares of the Cyprus Popular Bank closed at 3.23, losing 13.5 cents from last week's close of 3.35 1/2. The Popular Bank is due to announce its six monthly results on Tuesday.

Hellenic Bank HBCP.CY closed at 2.57 1/2 from last Friday's close of 3.03 1/2. On Thursday it announced a 41.3 increase in operating profits to reach 4.08 million pounds in the first half of the year.
-- Michele Kambas, Nicosia newsroom 357 2 365089 ($1=.46 Cyprus pound)
